title: Google's Video AI Drops From 10¢ To 7¢ A Second Dec 3
description:
Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video output $17.50 to $12.00 per 1M tokens (about $0.10 to $0.07 per second of 720p video) when requests reroute to Omni 1.2 Flash on Dec 3, 2026. Source: aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing
